_what: Every reading, offered reading or move on a word of the standing sentence fixed between Session 85 and Session 119, for S85.OVERLOAD and S92.FIRSTTERM. Hand-built, Session 120. count.py checks each quote byte-exact (Markdown emphasis ignored) and counts per word with Session 85's readings.json.
_criterion: Session 85's: a note declares, in its own text, that it is saying what a word of the standing sentence names or does. status: 'fixed' if the note takes it into the position; 'offered' if the note records it and declines to take it; 'move' if the sentence's words changed.
_search: Journals of Sessions 93-119 and position papers 2026-09-18 to 2026-10-07 searched for 'reading of', 'reading at', 'fourth reading' and the form 'an observer ... is'. No paragraph of the form 'an observer here is X' was found after Session 92.
